name: games.markan/markan
title: Markan: Steam market data
description: Steam game data and sales estimates for indie game market research. Free, no account.

tools.name: find_games
tools.description: Find Steam games matching filters, e.g. every game tagged both 'Cozy' and 'Farming Sim', released since 2022, priced $10-25, with at least 100 reviews. Tags are Steam's user tags (case-insensitive); all given tags must match. Returns up to 50 games, sorted by review count unless asked otherwise, plus how many matched in total. Use estimate_sales on the results for sales estimates.

max_price_usd.description: Highest list price (before discounts) in US dollars.

max_reviews.description: Most Steam user reviews, e.g. to leave out breakout hits.

min_price_usd.description: Lowest list price (before discounts) in US dollars, e.g. 9.99. 0 includes free games.

min_reviews.description: Fewest Steam user reviews. Reviews track sales, so this filters out games that sold little.

sort.description: Most reviews first, newest or oldest release first, or cheapest first.

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Find Steam games and DLC by title (or by Steam ID). Returns up to 5 matches, most-reviewed first.

query.description: Part of the title, or a numeric Steam ID.

tools.name: get_games
tools.description: Data for up to 50 Steam games by Steam ID. Prices are USD cents (basePrice, minimumPrice; minimumPrice is the lowest price Markan has seen, null if not yet known). storeListings: the stores selling the game (Steam, GOG, Epic, consoles...) with links. Choose fields to keep the answer small; default: steamId, title, type, releaseDate, basePrice, numReviews, reviewScoreDesc, shortDescription, tags, genres, developers, publishers.

fields.description: Which fields to return; leave out for a useful default set (title, release date, price, reviews, short description, tags...). Prices are in US cents.

steam_ids.description: Steam app IDs (the number in a store URL), from find_games or search_games.

tools.name: estimate_sales
tools.description: Rough lifetime sales and net revenue (low/medium/high) for up to 50 Steam games, computed exactly like Markan's spreadsheet add-ins: reviews x a release-year multiplier (Boxleiter method), and list price x sales x a factor for refunds, regional pricing, discounts, tax and Steam's cut. Estimates, not reported figures.

steam_ids.description: Steam app IDs (the number in a store URL), from find_games or search_games.
